# Heselo — https://heselo.online

> Məkan idarəetmə sistemi (venue management): rezervasiya, canlı zal, kassa və anbar.
> Languages: az (default), en, ru.

## Product

- Heselo is SaaS for gaming clubs (PlayStation), karaoke rooms, billiards, anti-cafés, and room lounges in Azerbaijan.
- Core modules: room/station/table booking, live floor sessions, POS/cash shift, inventory, customers, statistics.
- Payment balances are calculated on the server (not client-side estimates).
